arguments.sql: SELECT c.card_brand, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate, COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id GROUP BY c.card_brand ORDER BY c.card_brand
arguments.explanation: Computes the fraud rate for each card brand over labelled transactions, with the counts behind each rate.
assumptions: Fraud rate is computed over labelled transactions only (inner join to fraud_labels); unlabelled transactions are excluded.
The data covers 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31, all periods included.
Card brand is taken from the card used on each transaction (cards.card_brand).
